description: Scott championed conservatorship reform to get people in crisis the care they need, closed the "locked-door loophole" that let car break-in perpetrators avoid accountability, and worked with street vendors to stop the sale of stolen goods disrupting our neighborhoods. We can have both compassionate and sensible solutions to public safety, and in Congress, Scott will continue leading that fight.

title: Scott Wiener for Congress: Public Safety
